scope: Optional TexSampleUnit scalar/vector signed per-axis policy, prepared fault transport and full-width implicit LOD
previous_result_scope: Passing pre-boundary component controls, superseded by v2 after adding explicit partial-quad implicit-LOD rejection and scalar nonzero mip controls.

contract.snapshot: Policy, base, dimensions, format, mip limits and bias are captured at scalar/vector instruction admission and survive all lane/mip work despite poisoned live controls.
contract.faults: Aggregate over executed samples and retain with held scalar/vector completion. Suppress writeRd/writesVd on fault; owners must report/cancel faults before normal completion. Reserved modes, zero dimensions, inverted mip ranges and unsupported partial-quad implicit LOD issue no reads.
contract.empty: No executing vector lanes preserves old destination with no sampling or coordinate fault.
contract.lod: Full signed/unsigned edge differences feed the existing maximum-edge gradient contract. A 46-bit rho may produce exponent 29; apply signed bias using seven bits before narrowing to selected mip limits. Fractional selection retains the existing Q0.8 log LUT.
contract.nonquad: One/two-lane vectors support fixed mip sampling; implicit-LOD requests fault without reads. Scalar bias/clamp selection remains supported.
contract.cache: Invalidate at every instruction admission; different memory contents and binding formats across consecutive operations cannot reuse stale cached words.

limits: Native/task sampler descriptors and coordinate-fault owner integration remain unconnected. Instruction encodings, decoder and ABI bytes are unchanged; no new public shader/native mode is exposed.

These are execute-side component requests and exact output/ownership checks, not a new actual-CU shader program or native policy run. Floating coordinate conversion, complete resource/format/gradient/fetch semantics, precision conformance and throughput remain open.
Legacy synthesis-active SV, ports and hierarchy match four independent pre-extension emissions; no new area, clock, power or rate result is claimed.
The independent six-check native facing run passes; the 130-of-176 native depth checkpoint remains live and is not part of this 22-check result.
No T03/T04/H4/H6/H0-H8 or GLES closure. PPA remains synthesis only.
